posts.name: bolnerap
posts.cooked:
Mint with Visionary at 7 and Mr. Fixer at 4.

Visionary was easily the MVP. Played Telekinetic Cocoon turn 1 and watched a pile of damage get plinked off of it as people tried to hit the highest HP hero. First I focused on getting Fanatic's cards out ASAP until she got Final Dive, then Visionary helped Fixer draw more. 

Fanatic got out Divine Focus on her first power use and piled some damage on Fright Train, then Final Dived away Major Flay so we could start getting stuff done.

I made a potentially HUGE mistake by blowing up the Explosives Barrel when Sgt Steel had Espionagent out. Totally forgot about his rules, I don't play Villains all that often. The Barrel would have wiped his board, but instead they all just sat there. The damage KO'd Fright Train, and severely wounded MI and Fanatic.

Next, I had Visionary Suggest Twisted Reality back on top of MI's deck. This let Fanatic go out in style with back to back Brutal Censures (I'd lost Wrathful Retribution thanks to MI bottom-decking it with her end-of-turn ability), then let Fixer get completely set up. The Environment obliged with a Sustain the Portal, which combined with Driving Mantis got MI dead, destroying Twisted Reality for me.

From there taking out Sgt. Steel's minions and him was pretty straightforward. Vis and Fixer piled on the damage and I used Fanatic's incap to pass Fixer more powers. Never saw any of the gunmen or the Sheriff.

posts.name: QuirkyDM
posts.cooked:
Spent too much time worrying about getting Chrono-Ranger, so I had jumped into this today. Ended up with Fine after falling for the trap the first time. I thought I could work around it with Final Dive and Wrath of Retribution, but Fright Train's Off the Rails took down the team eventually.

Second time, I tried Final Diving Major Flay right away, but just succumbed to the huge amount of damage and didn't come back.

Third time was the charm. Like some others, I got a lucky Precognition to ensure Sergeant Steel could be damaged and then took him down to 2 along with everyone else within Explosive Wagons range of death. End of Days came out and lived up to its name.
